items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Well that's what we called him, Wild Batman. He was a tenor player in the band.

ctx.x: You reminded me, did you know a guy named Batman?
Batman was in there, yeah, Batman was the title. Well that's what we called him, Wild Batman. He was a tenor player in the band.
Yeah, his name was Leroy Rankins?
